scope: Four government-matched Lantau forms remaining after the final fourteen-form compute pass

rows.observation: Exact object and CSUID match, 91.4% footprint overlap and 0.16 m centroid offset. Aligning unchanged government geometry to recorded TopHeight still leaves the highest roof 0.45 m below sampled terrain at its roof point and up to 2.50 m below rendered terrain in the surface check.
rows.nextDependency: Reconcile official terrain height or obtain a corrected source height; do not raise the mesh arbitrarily.

rows.observation: The source has the exact object and CSUID but its horizontal envelope and centroid do not fit the matched building; the official loader rejects it as 'Official model does not fit its matched footprint'.
rows.nextDependency: Identify the correct government component or corrected building footprint before import.
